name: rowAvgsPerColSet
title: Applies a row-by-row averaging function to equally-sized subsets of matrix columns

origin.description: Applies a row-by-row averaging function to equally-sized subsets of matrix columns. Each subset is averaged independently of the others.
origin.usage:
rowAvgsPerColSet(X, W = NULL, rows = NULL, S, FUN = rowMeans, ...,
  na.rm = NA, tFUN = FALSE)

arguments.name: X
arguments.text: A numeric N by M matrix.

arguments.name: W
arguments.text: An optional numeric N by M matrix of weights.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: A vector indicating a subset of rows to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: S
arguments.text: An integer K by J matrix specifying the J subsets. Each column holds K column indexes for the corresponding subset.

arguments.name: FUN
arguments.text: The row-by-row function used to average over each subset of X. This function must accept a numeric N by K matrix and the logical argument na.rm, and return a numeric vector of length N.

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: Logical argument passed to FUN as na.rm. If NA, which is the default, then na.rm = TRUE is used if X or S holds missing values, otherwise na.rm = FALSE.

arguments.name: tFUN
arguments.text: If TRUE, the N by K matrix passed to FUN is transposed first.

origin.details: If argument S is a single column vector with indices 1:N, then rowAvgsPerColSet(X, S = S, FUN = rowMeans) gives the same result as rowMeans(X).
origin.value: A numeric N by J matrix. Row names come from X and column names come from S. One column is one column-set.

translation.description: Applies a row-by-row averaging function to equally-sized subsets of matrix columns. Each subset is averaged independently of the others.
translation.usage:
rowAvgsPerColSet(X, W=None, rows=None, S=None, FUN=None, na_rm=None,
  t_fun=False, **kwargs)

arguments.name: X
arguments.text: A 2-d numeric array. Axis 0 is rows and axis 1 is columns, matching the printed R matrix.

arguments.name: W
arguments.text: An optional numeric array with the same shape as X. The installed function clears the column index before subsetting W, so FUN receives those rows and zero columns.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: A base-R row subscript, 1-based when numeric. None keeps every row. Zero is dropped, negatives exclude, and a logical index is recycled.

arguments.name: S
arguments.text: A 2-d array of 1-based column indexes. Each column is one set. Non-finite indexes are dropped, then the remaining values follow R [ rules.

arguments.name: FUN
arguments.text: Callable applied to each column subset. It must accept the subset and na_rm, and return one value per row. None uses the base row-means rule. Extra keywords are passed through.

arguments.name: na_rm
arguments.text: Passed to FUN as na_rm. None matches R's NA: missing values are removed when X or S has any, and kept otherwise.

arguments.name: t_fun
arguments.text: When True, the column subset is transposed before FUN. This is tFUN.

translation.details: A single set holding every column index, with the default mean, matches the row means of X. The result is a plain array with one row per selected row and one column per set. Names are not attached.
translation.value: A numeric array of shape (selected rows, number of sets).
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from matrixstats.rowavgs import rowAvgsPerColSet

rowAvgsPerColSet(np.array([[1, 3, 5], [2, 4, 6]], dtype=float), S=np.array([[1, 2], [2, 3]]))
